title: Enable systemd user lingering to keep services running after logout
summary: Keep your systemd user services running even after you log out of your graphical session or terminal. This is useful for background tasks that need to persist.

steps.explain: Enable lingering for your current user. This prevents the systemd user instance from being killed when your last session closes.

verify.expect: Your user should appear in the list with LINGER set to 'yes'.

rollback.explain: Disable lingering for your current user.
